data.description: A leucrotta's bite attack always applies 1-1/2 times its Strength modifier on damage rolls and threatens a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.  When a leucrotta bites an object, its bite treats the object as having a hardness of 5 less than the object's actual hardness rating.
data.name: Powerful Bite
